body:
🟡📝 **Consider · docs: Spec describes an implementation that differs from what this PR ships**

The spec says it is the contract ("this file wins"), but the code differs from it. (1) `forceReset` aborts writer sessions via `RecordingWriter.abortAll()` in the spec (lines 17, 54-78, 215-223). The PR adds only `ids()` and keeps `writer.releaseAll()` (recording-hub.ts:862-863), which keeps the partial files on disk. The writer test also covers only `ids`. (2) The spec's `barGeneration` counter and `activity.active` check (lines 203-212) are not in the hub. The bar is already guarded by `take !== takeCount` (recording-hub.ts:691). (3) The `ControlBarWindow` `wanted` flag (Task 3) already exists (control-bar-window.ts:50, 116) and is not part of this diff. As written, the doc describes behaviour that does not exist, and "Closes: REC-B3, REC-B4" is not backed by this diff. Update the spec to match the shipped design (releaseAll, existing bar guards) or note the deviations.

Fixed in 34d46d16: the spec now opens with a dated "Shipped deviations" note naming the three differences (`releaseAll` kept instead of `abortAll`, per its own Global Constraints on plan 22; no `barGeneration` because `main` already guards `bar.show` with `takeCount` + `activity.active`; the `wanted` flag predates this PR). The copied plan body stays as approved; "Closes REC-B3" is stated as resting on `main` plus this PR's tests, not on this diff alone.
